result.reason: The clause appropriately extends use to Affiliates and contractors, limits revocation of subscription licences to specified uncured material breaches after notice and cure, and permits transfers to successors under Section 24. However, Section 13.3 applies its revocation exception to any licence, creating a conflict with Section 13.2’s requirement that paid-up licences be irrevocable. Section 13.3 should expressly exclude licences granted under Section 13.2. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent.
